title: Mate in three

steps.text: A mate in three is found the same way: checks first, and replies that are forced. Black's back rank is guarded only by the rook.
Take the pawn beside the king, with check. Your rook guards the queen there.
steps.hint: The queen takes on the diagonal toward the king.
steps.after: The king's only square is the corner.

steps.text: Give the queen on the back rank, with check. The rook has to take her.
steps.hint: One step forward for the queen, still guarded by your rook.
steps.after: Forced: only the black rook could take the queen.

steps.hint: Your rook takes on the back rank.
steps.after: Back-rank mate in three moves, every one of them a check.

steps.text: Find all three moves yourself. Start with the check that gives a rook.

wrong.b3g8: The rook takes the queen. Nothing guards g8 yet.

steps.hint: One rook goes to the back rank. The other stands behind it.
steps.after: The rook took it. Had the king stepped aside instead, the queen would mate on g8 at once.

steps.text: Take back on the back rank, with check.
steps.hint: Your second rook takes the rook.
steps.after: The king must step out of the corner.

steps.hint: The rook now guards the square next to the king.
steps.after: Checkmate. The rook guards the queen, and the king's own pawns block it in.

summary: Longer mates are found like short ones: try every check, follow the forced replies, and look for the mate at the end.
